## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Leadership concentrated in Technology (Top 5 span 3 sectors) with mixed internals and multiple large-cap divergences, providing two confirmations for a neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?  
Technology leads: MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND. Materials strong: FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND. Financials steady: JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?  
Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND. Utilities and Energy showing weakness: XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION, EOG (1W: -5.05% | 1M: -0.99%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?  
Top 5: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, EL (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +26.25%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.52% | 1M: +21.87%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Moderate concentration (Top 5 across 3 sectors).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?  
Bottom 5: OXY (1W: -3.82% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION, INTU (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION, COP (1W: -3.98% | 1M: +10.44%) CORRECTION, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, TJX (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -16.70%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Consumer Discretionary and Energy.

6. Momentum Stocks?  
Strongest 1W momentum: CRM (1W: +22.69%), EL (1W: +10.46%), FCX (1W: +10.11%) — all ABOVE TREND. Major divergence present (≥3 large caps with 1W ≠ 1M: AAPL RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, XOM CORRECTION) — treat moves as tactical, not full regime confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?  
Technology positive on 1W (sector up +3.71%) with many leaders ABOVE TREND: MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +5.13% | 1M: +19.98%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +29.05%) ABOVE TREND; internal rotation visible as several large names show short-term divergence. Sector breadth: positive (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?  
Financials mildly positive (1W +1.50%) with JPM (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +2.76%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +3.81% | 1M: +3.16%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +3.12% | 1M: +5.04%) ABOVE TREND supporting stability; watch GS headlines (-75 sentiment) for tactical volatility. Sector breadth: positive (20 stocks).

9. Healthcare Outlook?  
Healthcare mixed-to-soft (1W -0.33%) with LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND and JNJ (1W: -0.11% | 1M: +0.58%) CORRECTION; several bullish FDA headlines (BMY/ABT/AMGN) create idiosyncratic catalysts but sector internals are mixed. Sector breadth: mixed (17 stocks).

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?  
Maintain neutral positioning: favor exposure to Financials and Materials given steady/strong 1W leaders (JPM ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to purely momentum-long Tech names until 1M confirmation; style: mixed / no clear leadership. Monitor large-cap divergences (AAPL RECOVERY, META RECOVERY) for trend confirmation before adding exposure.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: CRM (1W: +22.69% | 1M: +33.80%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.11% | 1M: +30.72%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +4.97% | 1M: +29.57%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: LLY (1W: -5.49% | 1M: -2.66%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -5.84% | 1M: +0.45%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?  
BULLISH: Technology (sector up 1W with multiple leaders ABOVE TREND; breadth positive), Materials (FCX ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (weak breadth; NKE/TJX BELOW TREND), Utilities/Energy showing short-term softness.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?  
Monitor NVDA for continuation above recent highs to confirm tech momentum and MSFT for follow-through on 1M strength; watch AAPL (RECOVERY) for failure to reclaim 1M trend as a sign of broader tech rotation. For cyclicals, watch FCX and JPM for sustained ABOVE TREND performance to confirm risk appetite.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?  
BA (+65): Boeing (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -1.93%) BELOW TREND — positive contract headline but price is diverging, watch for earnings/contract confirmation. AMGN (+60): Amgen (news-positive) — catalyst visible but sector internals mixed; cross-ref with price for confirmation. ABT (+80): Abbott (news-positive) — actionable catalyst; verify price follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?  
GS (-75): Goldman Sachs — heavy negative headlines; cross-check price action before positioning. INTU (-45): Intuit (1W: -3.83% | 1M: +4.46%) CORRECTION — negative sentiment aligns with short-term pullback vs longer 1M strength. NKE (-35): Nike (1W: -4.40% | 1M: -11.06%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with style mixed / no clear leadership. CRM, MSFT, NVDA ABOVE TREND and Financials/Materials showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence among large caps (AAPL RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, XOM CORRECTION) and several bullish headlines diverging from price (e.g., BA +65 sentiment but BELOW TREND).
